description: This file implements a transformation layer for Pydantic AI agents, handling request sending, polling for task completion, and simulating streaming responses by chunking non-streaming responses. It defines a class with static methods for processing and converting responses, including fake streaming generation.

classes.name: PydanticAITransformation
classes.description: A class providing static methods to handle request processing, response transformation, and fake streaming for Pydantic AI agents following the A2A protocol.

methods.name: _remove_none_values
methods.description: Recursively removes None values from dict or list structures to comply with FastA2A/Pydantic AI requirements.

methods.name: _params_to_dict
methods.description: Converts parameters, including Pydantic models, into a dictionary format, handling different Pydantic versions.

methods.name: _poll_for_completion
methods.description: Polls the task status endpoint until the task is completed, failed, or canceled, with a maximum number of attempts.

methods.name: _send_and_poll_raw
methods.description: Sends a request to the Pydantic AI agent and polls for completion, returning the raw task response.

methods.name: send_non_streaming_request
methods.description: Sends a non-streaming request to the Pydantic AI agent and waits for the completed response.

methods.name: send_and_get_raw_response
methods.description: Sends a request and returns the raw response, used for obtaining data for fake streaming.

methods.name: _transform_to_a2a_response
methods.description: Transforms a Pydantic AI task response into a standard A2A non-streaming response format.

methods.name: _extract_response_text
methods.description: Extracts the textual response, message ID, and parts from a completed task response, prioritizing artifacts, then history, then message field.

methods.name: fake_streaming_from_response
methods.description: Converts a completed non-streaming response into a sequence of fake streaming events, including task, status updates, and artifact chunks.
